clean_studio.name: Clean Studio / White Background
clean_studio.scene: seamless white studio backdrop, product centered on an invisible surface
clean_studio.lighting: large soft key light front-left, fill card right, even shadowless wrap, 5500K neutral
clean_studio.camera: 85mm product lens, eye-level, product occupying 70% of frame height
clean_studio.background_hint: neutral white to very light gray vertical gradient
clean_studio.shadow: soft faint contact shadow directly beneath product

editorial_beauty.name: Editorial Beauty / Skincare
editorial_beauty.scene: matte pastel stone pedestal, soft beige studio, one out-of-focus botanical sprig far behind
editorial_beauty.lighting: diffused north-window softbox left, gentle top fill, 5000K, airy highlights
editorial_beauty.camera: 70mm, three-quarter angle at product height, generous negative space above
editorial_beauty.background_hint: soft beige-pink seamless with gentle vignette
editorial_beauty.shadow: long soft shadow falling right, low contrast

flat_lay.name: Flat Lay / Top-Down
flat_lay.scene: textured linen or paper surface viewed directly from above, minimal side props at corners
flat_lay.lighting: large overhead diffused source, perfectly even, no directional bias, 5500K
flat_lay.camera: top-down 90 degrees, product centered with even margins
flat_lay.shadow: very soft ambient occlusion ring only

lifestyle_kitchen.name: Lifestyle Kitchen
lifestyle_kitchen.scene: light oak countertop, blurred bright kitchen interior behind, morning atmosphere
lifestyle_kitchen.lighting: warm window light from rear-left, white bounce card front, 4800K
lifestyle_kitchen.camera: 50mm at counter height, shallow depth of field, background bokeh
lifestyle_kitchen.background_hint: warm cream tones, soft horizontal counter line, bokeh circles top third
lifestyle_kitchen.shadow: natural directional shadow to the right, diffused edge

luxury_hero.name: Luxury Hero
luxury_hero.scene: polished black stone slab, dark charcoal void background, subtle rim glow
luxury_hero.lighting: single dramatic strip softbox from above-behind, warm 4300K accent kicker, deep controlled falloff
luxury_hero.camera: 100mm macro product lens, slightly low hero angle, tight premium crop
luxury_hero.background_hint: near-black gradient with faint warm rim halo behind product
luxury_hero.shadow: crisp short contact shadow, slight reflection on slab

minimal_tabletop.name: Minimalist Tabletop
minimal_tabletop.scene: single matte neutral podium on a plain light-gray sweep, no props
minimal_tabletop.lighting: one large overhead softbox, minimal fill, 5200K, sculpted but simple
minimal_tabletop.camera: 85mm, straight-on at product center, symmetrical framing
minimal_tabletop.background_hint: uniform light gray, very subtle floor-wall seam low in frame
minimal_tabletop.shadow: single soft ellipse under podium edge

natural_outdoor.name: Natural Outdoor
natural_outdoor.scene: weathered stone or wood surface outdoors, softly blurred green foliage background
natural_outdoor.lighting: open-shade daylight with dappled sun accents, 5600K, gentle sky fill
natural_outdoor.camera: 60mm at surface level, low horizon, background defocused
natural_outdoor.background_hint: muted green wash with soft dappled light patches
natural_outdoor.shadow: soft dappled shadow consistent with foliage light

reflective_surface.name: Reflective Surface / Mirror
reflective_surface.scene: glossy reflective black acrylic surface, dark gradient studio behind
reflective_surface.lighting: two strip softboxes left/right for symmetric edge highlights, 5000K
reflective_surface.camera: 90mm at surface level, product with clear mirror reflection below
reflective_surface.background_hint: dark neutral gradient, no visible horizon
reflective_surface.shadow: reflection fades with distance, minimal ambient shadow

seasonal_holiday.name: Seasonal / Holiday
seasonal_holiday.scene: festive tabletop with restrained seasonal accents (pine sprig, warm bokeh lights far behind)
seasonal_holiday.lighting: warm tungsten key 3800K with cool rim separation, gentle sparkle highlights
seasonal_holiday.camera: 70mm, slightly elevated 15 degrees, product hero with accents at frame edges only
seasonal_holiday.background_hint: deep warm amber gradient with distant gold bokeh
seasonal_holiday.shadow: warm soft shadow, subtle festive glow at base

social_ad.name: Social Ad
social_ad.scene: bold single-color backdrop with graphic diagonal light band, product floating slightly above surface
social_ad.lighting: hard directional key for a defined graphic shadow, colored gel accent from rear, high contrast
social_ad.camera: 50mm, dynamic slight tilt, product upper-center leaving copy space bottom-left
social_ad.background_hint: saturated solid color with diagonal lighter band
social_ad.shadow: hard-edged graphic drop shadow offset down-right
